Company Description Bejite is a talent and career platform designed to connect employers and recruiters with relevant candidates while helping job seekers find roles that match their skills and goals. The platform streamlines candidate discovery and screening, allowing hiring teams to focus on engaging the most suitable talent. Job seekers can build professional profiles, showcase their skills and experience, and increase their visibility to potential employers. Beyond a traditional job board, Bejite aims to create an ecosystem where talent can grow, employers can discover skilled professionals, and meaningful career opportunities can emerge. Whether organizations are hiring or individuals are exploring their next step, Bejite is built to move users from searching to connecting.
Role Description The Backend Development Intern role is a remote internship focused on supporting the development and improvement of Bejite’s backend systems and services. Day-to-day tasks include assisting in the design, implementation, and testing of APIs; working with databases to store, retrieve, and manage application data; and contributing to performance optimization and debugging efforts. The intern will collaborate with other developers to integrate backend services with frontend applications and third-party tools, while following best practices for code quality, security, and documentation. This role also involves participating in code reviews, learning from peer feedback, and supporting the team in delivering reliable features that enhance the platform experience for employers and job seekers.
Qualifications
 

- Foundational skills in at least one backend programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Node.js, or similar) and familiarity with RESTful APIs or microservices.
- Basic understanding of relational or NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and experience writing simple queries or data models.
- Knowledge of version control tools (e.g., Git) and comfort working in collaborative development environments.
- Awareness of web application fundamentals, including security, performance, and scalability concepts.
- Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new technologies and frameworks.
- Effective communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote, distributed team.
- Current enrollment in, or recent completion of, a program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
- Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) or containerization tools (e.g., Docker) is a plus but not required.
